definitions.explanation: A formal process by which people vote to choose a person for a public office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧{選挙|せんきょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{選挙|せんきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投票|とうひょう}し→投票する：03453_touhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to vote in the election.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}された→発表する：03562_happyou⟧。

notes:
{選挙|せんきょ} refers to the formal process of electing public officials through voting. It covers elections at all levels — national, prefectural, and municipal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {選挙|せんきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to run in an election (as a candidate)
- {選挙|せんきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{投票|とうひょう}する→投票する：03453_touhyou⟧: to vote in an election
- {選挙|せんきょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧/⟦{負|ま}ける→負ける：01134_makeru⟧: to win/lose an election
- ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}{権|けん}→選挙権：10427_senkyoken⟧: voting rights, suffrage
- ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}{運動|うんどう}→選挙運動：26087_senkyoundou⟧: election campaign
- {選挙|せんきょ}⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: election results

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{総|そう}→総：03958_sou⟧{選挙|せんきょ}: general election
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧{選挙|せんきょ}: local election
